tools.name: Code editor, such as Visual Studio Code
Xcode and an iOS Simulator runtime
Expo client compatible with SDK 53, or a team-provided development build

notes: npm run setup installs all project packages from package.json using package-lock.json. Expo CLI is included; no global Expo installation is needed.
Install Node.js and Git first. Xcode and simulator runtimes must be installed separately through Apple; npm cannot install them.
An Expo account is useful for team builds and hosted Expo services, but is not required to start the local development server.
